collected: 2026-10-13 UTC (evening of 2026-10-12, Eastern time): search pages 01:41 to 01:52 UTC; property pages 01:38 to 02:34 UTC; listing remarks 01:54 to 02:35 UTC; Beach Pro Team cross-check 01:50 to 02:40 UTC
status: unverified research data for ledger batches/2026-10-b/facts/no-hoa-facts.md (listing rows); verifier columns there are empty

source.primary: mbcoastalhomes.realgeeks.com (RE/MAX Southern Shores Real Geeks site), search results and /property/<MLS#>/ pages. Data provided courtesy of the Coastal Carolinas Association of REALTORS MLS. robots.txt allows /search/results/ and /property/; it disallows /search/details/, which was not opened.
source.crossCheck: beachproteam.com /listings/view/<MLS#>.html, a sample, 10 seconds apart (robots.txt Crawl-delay: 10). Both sites repeat one MLS feed, so agreement checks transcription, not a second source.
source.field: 'HOA Fees (Calculated Monthly)' on the Real Geeks property page. A listing 'with an HOA fee' shows the field; 'no HOA fee' means the field is absent. No listing showed a value of 0. Beach Pro Team shows 'Hoa: Yes' and 'Hoa Fees:' when the field is filled and neither when it is not.

method: Searched /search/results/?city=<city>&type=res (the site's 'Home' type) and &type=con (its 'Condo' type) for each of ten mailing cities: Myrtle Beach, North Myrtle Beach, Conway, Surfside Beach, Garden City Beach, Murrells Inlet, Little River, Loris, Aynor and Longs. The site shows at most 250 results per search, so searches over 250 were split by list price (list_price_min/list_price_max), in $50,000 steps and then $10,000 steps where needed. Every split's listing count was summed and every listing was de-duplicated by MLS number; each city and type reached the site's own total.
Opened /property/<MLS#>/ for each of the 6,231 listings, about one a second per worker, three workers. 6,228 opened; 3 returned 404 (taken off the market during the run): 2608602, 2624058, 2623166.

Area = the listing's mailing city, except that Myrtle Beach listings whose MLS Region is '10b Myrtle Beach Area--Carolina Forest' are counted as Carolina Forest, and Surfside Beach and Garden City Beach are combined. A mailing city is not a town limit: a 'Myrtle Beach' address can be in unincorporated Horry County.

'Homes' = the site's Home type (Property Type Detached, Semi-Detached, Other, Garage or blank). 'Detached houses' = Property Type 'Detached'. 'Condo class' = the site's Condo type (Property Type Condominium, Townhouse or Apartment).
Status: the site lists ACTIVE and ACTIVE UNDER CONTRACT; both are counted. Active-only figures are in byArea.*.homesActiveOnly and condosActiveOnly.

Leased land: 82 no-fee homes are in three MLS neighborhoods where a listing's remarks say the home sits on leased land with a yearly lease, or the neighborhood is named a campground (Ocean Lakes 80, Apache Campground 1, Bermuda Bay 1). ownedLandOnly leaves them out of both the count of no-fee homes and the count of all homes.

Remarks: the description of every no-fee listing was read again from its property page and sorted by text pattern (see remarksOnNoFeeListings). Two no-fee listings' remarks mention an HOA or community dues (2602489 'Registered HOA', 2621733 'Landscaping is included in the community dues'); seven mention a voluntary or optional association.
Medians are of list prices and of the monthly fee as the MLS field shows it. List prices are asking prices, not sale prices.
Longs is reported but kept out of the 'allNineAreas' totals, which cover the nine areas in the brief.
